title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3 (B14 Rev2 fan mod)
required_inputs: derive and validate an EE function map for the mod revision (the current probe copies USA boundaries)
validate the generated 9-program VU1 manifest against BT4 execution
derive and validate the DBZ4.BIN overlay map and hooks (the current probe uses DBZP.BIN and USA boundaries)
notes: The mod ISO contains DBZP.BIN plus DBZ4.BIN. The experimental runner builds and boots from the mod ELF, loads the IOP modules, and passes DTX/SJX initialisation after registering the region-independent DTX compatibility override. It then remains before the first rendered frame with dma/gif around 1,700 and the guest allocator as the hot path. The EE and overlay maps are still provisional USA copies, so this is not a validated port and has no launcher profile.
